What We’re All About 
 Any company can tell you about how they are a multi award winning, market leading business and yes, we are both of those things in the world of IoT connectivity! But we’re more than that. 🌍✨ Our mission? To make IoT management a breeze for any device, anywhere. With over 10 million IoT subscriptions active in 165 countries and direct partnerships with 50 mobile networks , we connect you to more than 750 networks worldwide, delivering unmatched value across the IoT connectivity chain.
 Innovation is in our DNA , and we have an insatiable hunger to ‘wow’! 🚀 While we may not always get it right, our drive to collaborate, innovate, and achieve top-notch customer satisfaction never wavers. We offer industry expertise, stellar service support, and the most flexible, resilient, and secure connectivity solutions on the market. Our expertise spans across various sectors, including industry, agriculture, healthcare, security, transport, utilities, and smart cities.
 IoT… a fancy acronym or a secret code? 
 The Internet of Things (IoT) is like the magical glue that keeps the world connected! 🌐✨ From ordering your favourite takeaway to the ANPR technology that helps you find a parking spot, IoT is everywhere—even if you don’t realize it. At Wireless Logic , we provide cutting-edge connectivity solutions and technologies to ensure a vast array of devices stay seamlessly connected.
 Senior NOC Engineer - Romania 
 About The Role 
 You will protect production service availability across the Wireless Logic estate. You will spot issues early, assess impact, diagnose across multiple domains, carry out approved recovery actions and escalate to the right teams or suppliers. You stay in control until service is restored and handed over.
 What You Will Do 
Monitor alerts, dashboards and supplier notifications across networks, mobile connectivity platforms, infrastructure and applications
Validate alerts, assess impact and priority, and raise incident records
Diagnose issues using logs, traces, monitoring data and approved tools
Run approved recovery runbooks within agreed limits
Escalate to resolver teams, MNOs, carriers and suppliers with clear evidence
Confirm recovery and complete structured shift handovers
Help improve runbooks, alert tuning and automation
Rotate as Shift Lead once qualified, owning prioritisation, major incident coordination and communication
 What You Will Bring 
Strong experience in a NOC, infrastructure operations or 24x7 production support environment
Solid network fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, firewalls, load balancing and VPNs
Understanding of mobile and IoT connectivity: APNs, SIM sessions, roaming and RADIUS
Hands-on monitoring experience with PRTG, Grafana or similar
Working knowledge of VMware, Dell servers and storage
Confident Linux and Windows Server troubleshooting
Awareness of MySQL and SQL Server, plus core services such as AD, NTP and certificates
Good ITSM discipline, including incident records, escalation and handover
Experience in major incidents and supplier escalations
Fluent English with clear written incident updates
 Nice to have 
Mobile core or carrier experience
Scripting in PowerShell, Bash or Python
CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet, Microsoft, Linux, VMware, database or ITIL certifications
 Who You Are 
Calm and methodical under pressure
Evidence-led and curious
Dependable in a shift environment
Collaborative across cultures and time zones
Quick to ask for help when needed
 Wireless Logic Group unites and brings people together. We accomplish this when we lead with a lens of diversity, equity, and inclusion in everything we do.
